title: Imperial Shadow
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji's Tianji Record turned again, the ink-stained seventh page slowly revealed its fragmented text—'Blood for blood, life for life, this is not the way.'

text.content: Before the afterglow of the fusion light could fade, the Demon Path commander—or rather, the former commander—showed the first sign of living emotion in those eyes crawling with aberrant patterns. The chaotic battlefield fell into a deathly silence, with only Chen Ji standing in place, sensing a breath-starving familiar aura pressing from the horizon's end. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul whispered: 'They've come. The Imperial faction.' This was no ordinary oppression—but an absolute order force transcending borders and factions, like an invisible hand slowly overturning the entire world's chessboard.

A golden fissure split the sky. Not a crack, but a gaping wound. A carriage pulled by nine golden dragons broke through the clouds, its body inscribed with patterns mirroring the edge符文 of the Tianji Record fragment. Banners rippled—not the Demon Path's black lotus, nor the three major sects' insignias, but the Imperial sun-moon dragon emblem. Court officials' ceremonial robes and imperial procession rituals descended upon this battlefield soaked in blood and corpses.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly raised the fragment in his hand, eyes narrowing. He didn't move, didn't retreat. Instead, a barely perceptible smile curled at the corner of his mouth. 'The Imperial faction.' he repeated quietly, as if savoring the weight of these words, 'You've arrived just in time.' His right hand secretly gathered power, fingertips already touching the hidden seal on the fragment's final page—Mo Xiansheng's final trump card, never to be used unless absolutely necessary. Now, he wasn't certain whether that critical moment had truly arrived.

text.content: The carriage curtain was lifted by a pale, jade-like hand. That hand—Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. On that hand was unmistakably the same bloodline mark as his own, the unique 'Life Pattern' of the Chen family. The figure descended through the air, clad in dark imperial robes, with a handsome and dignified face, yet utterly hollow eyes. Silently, he stood ten zhang away from Chen Ji, his gaze passing over Chen Ji, the battlefield, and everyone, as if observing a predetermined ending.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently. 'Impossible... he died three hundred years ago!' Chen Ji's heart sank completely. Three hundred years ago was precisely when the first generation inheritor recorded in Chen family archives—Chen Xuan—'fell in the Ancient Forbidden Land'. He had passed down the Tianji Record fragment, established the Chen family lineage, and he—the candidate 'skipped' by the Tianji Record. Yet this person before him clearly possessed the aura of the living, but showed not a trace of living spirit. What flowed through his blood vessels seemed not blood, but solidified order.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Xuan.' Chen Ji spoke, his voice steady as if facing not a legendary figure at all, 'Three hundred years apart, the ancestor's elegance remains unchanged.' His tone carried three parts playfulness, three parts probing, three parts cold intent, and one part—wariness. Chen Xuan's lips barely twitched—not a smile, but more like some programmed muscle reflex. 'Three hundred years.' he said, his voice hollow as an echo, 'To you, it is three hundred years. To me, merely an endless dream.'

text.content: Chen Xuan raised that hand covered in Life Patterns, pointing toward the carriage pulled by nine golden dragons behind him. 'The Imperial faction is merely a piece on the chessboard. And I am the cage beside that piece.' His tone held nofluctuation, as if stating the simplest fact, 'Every emperor, every decision, every campaign—all emanate from Cang Yutian's will. And I am responsible for ensuring these wills remain uninterrupted by anyone.' Chen Ji's heart completely sank. Cang Yutian. That name repeatedly surfacing in Mo Xiansheng's scattered words, that ultimate chess player's agent—had long refined the Imperial faction into his grasp.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed. Not a cold laugh, but the kind that makes one's spine crawl—the laugh of one who has calculated to the extreme. 'So the ancestor's meaning is—' he deliberately prolonged his words, 'the Imperial faction's campaigns against the Demon Path, provoking internal strife among the three major sects, opening the Ancient Forbidden Land... all on Cang Yutian's chessboard? Including you personally transforming the Demon Path commander into that half-human, half-monster state?' Chen Xuan was silent for a moment, then nodded: 'Yes. Including today.'

text.content: A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. 'Including today?' He stepped forward, truly approaching this 'ancestor' for the first time, 'Then may I ask, why did Cang Yutian send you here—to take my life, or—' He deliberately paused, his gaze scanning Chen Xuan's hollow eyes, 'to make me a caged bird, a piece on the board?' Chen Xuan gave no answer. He merely gazed at Chen Ji, and in those eyes actually appeared a trace of—grief? That expression vanished in an instant, replaced by an exhaustion carved into the marrow.

dialogue.content: 'I came to request one thing from you.' Chen Xuan's voice suddenly changed. No longer hollow, no longer programmed, but carrying the weight and sorrow accumulated over three hundred years, 'I, Chen Xuan, was chosen and then abandoned by the Tianji Record three hundred years ago, and thus harbored hatred. Cang Yutian exploited this hatred, refining me into the guardian of the Imperial faction—in truth, a blade without self-awareness.' He slowly raised his hand, revealing dense restriction patterns on his inner arm, 'Each of these patterns connects to Cang Yutian's will. I cannot resist him, nor can I voluntarily end this body.'

Chen Ji said nothing. He was calculating rapidly. Chen Xuan's words were half true—the Tianji Record indeed 'skips' certain candidates, and those skipped often drift toward extremes. But his claim of 'being unable to resist'... Chen Ji slightly narrowed his eyes, the Tianji Record fragment in his sleeve faintly burning. He waited, for a signal sufficient to support his judgment. Chen Xuan also seemed to sense his hesitation, suddenly taking a step forward—that movement abrupt and stiff, as if the body did not belong to him.

'But there is one thing Cang Yutian miscalculated.' Chen Xuan's voice suddenly dropped extremely low, low enough for only Chen Ji to hear, 'Those chosen by the Tianji Record possess natural immunity to 'Heavenly Mandate' in their bloodline. My body is locked死的 by restrictions, but my bloodline—' He pointed to his own heart, 'still fights. Every moment, every breath, for three hundred years without end.' His gaze suddenly sharpened, 'And the Ancient Chess Player within you will understand my choice.'

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. The Ancient Chess Player—an existence Mo Xiansheng had never directly mentioned, only occasionally alluding to in his most vulnerable moments. The true source of the Tianji Record, surpassing Cang Yutian's ultimate chess player? Chen Xuan knew of this? His mind raced, each thread of cluescrazed connecting: Chen family bloodline, Tianji Record inheritance, Cang Yutian's three-hundred-year layout, the Ancient Chess Player—if Chen Xuan spoke truth, the level of this game far exceeded his imagination.

dialogue.content: Chen Xuan suddenly knelt on one knee. This action shocked everyone present—the nine golden dragons' driver, the distant demonic cultivator remnants, and Chen Ji himself most of all. 'I implore you—' Chen Xuan's voice was hoarse, each word seeming to tear from his throat, 'Kill me. Sever the link between Chen family bloodline and Cang Yutian. Only the inheritor's blood can end this three-hundred-year chain.' In his eyes, a glimmer of tears flickered past.

text.content: The battlefield fell into deathly silence. Chen Ji lowered his gaze to the 'ancestor' kneeling before him, the fragment in his hand already silently turned to the seventh page. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul whispered: 'What he said... some of it is true. But some of it is precisely what Cang Yutian wants you to believe.' Chen Ji gave no response to Mo Xiansheng. He merely gazed at Chen Xuan, at those hollow yet tear-glistening eyes. Three hundred years of hatred, three hundred years of entrapment, three hundred years of struggle—all crystallized into this brief sentence. He must make a choice.

choice.prompt: Chen Xuan kneels before you, requesting in the name of Chen family's ancestor that you personally end his suffering—this is the sole method to break free from Cang Yutian's control, or another meticulously crafted trap? You must make a decision.

choices.description: Chen Xuan spoke correctly—only the inheritor's blood can sever the chain. Three hundred years of imprisonment would drive anyone to yearn for liberation. He has no reason to lie.
choices.visible_cost: Losing a Chen family ancestor, staining your hands with blood
choices.visible_reward: May sever Cang Yutian's control over Chen family bloodline
choices.risk_hint: If this is a trap, you will personally kill an ally and lose a crucial piece

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his hand, the fragment silently sliding into his palm from his sleeve. Staring at Chen Xuan's face, which mirrored the portraits in his memory, he suddenly smiled. 'Since the ancestor has a request—' his voice was soft, soft as muttering to himself, 'this junior shall surely fulfill it.' Sharp energy condensed at his fingertip, yet at the moment of imminent action—it slightly deviated.

text.content: That energy did not pierce toward Chen Xuan's heart, but violently exploded into the ground beneath Chen Xuan's feet! As dust scattered and burst, a hidden restriction formation within the earth was forcibly activated—this formation could only be triggered by Chen family bloodline, and the patterns flowing upon it unmistakably bore Cang Yutian's mark. 'As expected.' Chen Ji's smile cooled, 'The ancestor's acting has remained consistent over three hundred years.'

choices.description: Three hundred years of imprisonment agony, yet he could still maintain his sanity—this itself is a miracle. Since bloodline connects, there must be another way.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger Cang Yutian's countermeasure, losing the withdrawal opportunity
choices.visible_reward: If successful, may obtain a powerful ally-level ancestor
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian will not sit by while you destroy his pieces, countermeasures can come at any time

dialogue.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand, squatted down, meeting Chen Xuan at eye level. "Three hundred years in a cage, what's one more moment?" His voice was soft, yet carried an unusual certainty. "Ancestor, since you could kneel before me begging for death, why not try—let me break this cage?" In Chen Xuan's hollow eyes, a real ripple finally appeared.

text.content: Chen Ji extended his right hand, pressing against Chen Xuan's brow center. The power within the Tianji Record Fragment quietly surged, a warm force seeping through his palm into Chen Xuan's Mental Sea. Within it, he witnessed—three hundred years. Entire three hundred years of resistance. Chen Xuan had never surrendered, even as his body remained imprisoned, his soul collided with Cang Yutian's will every single moment. And his weapon was precisely the Chen family's natural immunity to "Heavenly Fate."

choices.description: To kill or not to kill are both traps. What Cang Yutian wants is not Chen Xuan's life, but for you to stain your hands with blood—then let him see what a true Chess Player looks like.
choices.visible_cost: Expose more trump cards to Cang Yutian
choices.visible_reward: May counterattack Cang Yutian, breaking the deadlock
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian already gazes upon this game, any irregular move will be magnified

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not act, nor did he refuse. He simply rose slowly, brushed the dust from his knees, a cryptic smile playing at the corner of his mouth. "Ancestor, you beg me to kill you—but have you ever wondered why Cang Yutian wanted you to appear before me in this way?" Chen Xuan's body stiffened slightly. Chen Ji continued: "What he wants is not your life, but my choice. To kill is wrong; not to kill is also wrong. This is the chess game he desires."

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly flipped open the fragment in his hand, and a power never before revealed burst forth. That was Mo Xiansheng's final hidden trump card—a blank page that had never been activated, upon which words were now inscribing themselves at an inconceivable speed: "Blood for blood, life for life, not this path." A shock flickered through Chen Xuan's eyes. And high above the nine heavens, the lips of some transcendent existence finally froze in their smile.

Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's voice exploded within Chen Ji's Mental Sea—not a warning, but some long-sealed memory awakening: "The seventh page... blank page... So that's it. So what I was always waiting for was not the inheritor making a choice, but the inheritor refusing to choose itself." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He lowered his head to look at that blank page writing itself, the words becoming clearer with each stroke, each character carrying the weight of three thousand years of civilization.

Chen Xuan slowly rose to his feet. The binding formation rune patterns on his body were receding at an inconceivable speed, as if some power was fundamentally dismantling Cang Yutian's control. His gaze finally gained focus, and in his eyes when looking at Chen Ji, for the first time appeared genuine emotion—that was gratification, relief, and more so an expectation spanning three hundred years. "You have done better than I did." He whispered, "What Cang Yutian wanted was never for you to kill me—what he wanted was 'choice' itself. As long as you chose, regardless of what you chose, that would be his victory."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji closed the fragment, gently exhaling a breath of turbid air. On his face there was no triumph, no relaxation, only a kind of serenity after seeing through the chess game. "So your three hundred years of kneeling supplication was a play from the beginning?" Chen Xuan shook his head: "Not entirely. I truly wanted liberation. But more importantly—" He raised his hand, pointing to Chen Ji's heart, "I wanted you to witness the answer on the seventh page with your own eyes. The ancient Chess Player within you... will understand my choice." As his words fell, Chen Xuan's body began to dissolve into motes of light.

text.content: Those motes of light did not scatter, but transformed into a warm golden current, directly entering Chen Ji's brow center. Not an attack, not an intrusion—three hundred years of accumulation, three hundred years of resistance, three hundred years of obsession, all transforming into inheritance as it flooded his Mental Sea. Chen Ji closed his eyes, feeling that power surging through his meridians. The Tianji Record Fragment automatically flipped to the seventh page, and on that blank page, the words had fully appeared—"Blood for blood, life for life, not this path. Only the one who refuses to choose may shatter the heavens." He opened his eyes, looking toward where his ancestor had finally dissipated, and softly said: "I will remember."

The battlefield returned to silence. The carriage pulled by the nine golden dragons was slowly dissipating, along with all traces of the dynasty—as if it had never existed. The Demonic Path commander silently watched everything from afar, then turned and silently vanished into the darkness. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed weakly: "The seventh page... has finally appeared. But Cang Yutian will not take this lying down. He has been scheming for three hundred years—will he truly abandon the entire game just because one Chen Xuan dissolved?" Chen Ji did not answer. He merely tucked the fragment into his sleeve, then raised his head, gazing toward that gaze that seemed to be watching from above the clouds. "I know." He said softly, "So I'm waiting—for his next move."
